title: The Message at the Wrong Time
title_ja: タイミングが悪かったメッセージ
fact_notes: 登場人物・出来事・観察結果は架空の教材例。実測値・実在資料を主張しない。リンクは制作台帳であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: Amir and Yuki were preparing a presentation for their class.
sentences.ja: アミルとユキはクラスの発表を準備していた。

sentences.en: They agreed to finish their slides by Thursday evening.
sentences.ja: 木曜の夜までにスライドを完成させると約束した。

sentences.en: Amir sent Yuki a message asking about her progress.
sentences.ja: アミルはユキに進み具合を尋ねるメッセージを送った。

sentences.en: Several hours passed without a reply from her.
sentences.ja: 彼女から返事がないまま数時間が過ぎた。

sentences.en: Amir began to worry that Yuki had forgotten the project.
sentences.ja: アミルはユキが計画を忘れたのではと心配し始めた。

sentences.en: He considered sending a long message expressing his disappointment.
sentences.ja: がっかりした気持ちを表す長いメッセージを送ろうか考えた。

sentences.en: However, he decided to ask one simple question first.
sentences.ja: しかしまず一つの簡単な質問をすることにした。

sentences.en: He asked whether she needed any help with the work.
sentences.ja: 作業に何か手助けが必要か尋ねた。

sentences.en: Yuki replied the following morning and explained her situation.
sentences.ja: ユキは翌朝返事をし、事情を説明した。

sentences.en: Her family had needed her help throughout the previous evening.
sentences.ja: 前の晩はずっと家族が彼女の助けを必要としていた。

sentences.en: She had completed her slides but had forgotten to send them.
sentences.ja: スライドは完成していたが送るのを忘れていた。

sentences.en: Amir was relieved when he received the finished files.
sentences.ja: 完成したファイルを受け取りアミルは安心した。

sentences.en: Together, they discussed how to avoid similar confusion next time.
sentences.ja: 二人は次回同じような混乱を避ける方法を話し合った。

sentences.en: They chose a shared folder for storing their work.
sentences.ja: 作業を保存する共有フォルダーを選んだ。

sentences.en: They also agreed on a time for checking messages.
sentences.ja: メッセージを確認する時刻にも合意した。

sentences.en: This arrangement helped both students understand each other's expectations.
sentences.ja: この取り決めは互いの期待を理解する助けになった。

sentences.en: During their presentation, Amir and Yuki worked well together.
sentences.ja: 発表中、アミルとユキはうまく協力した。

sentences.en: Amir remembered how quickly he had imagined a negative explanation.
sentences.ja: アミルは自分がいかに早く否定的な理由を想像したか思い出した。

sentences.en: He learned that a missing reply can have many causes.
sentences.ja: 返事がないことには多くの原因があり得ると学んだ。

sentences.en: A respectful question had prevented an unnecessary argument.
sentences.ja: 相手を尊重する質問が不要な口論を防いだ。

vocabulary.definition: a spoken explanation given to an audience
visual pages used in a presentation
sadness when expectations are not met
keep away from an unwanted event
used by more than one person
a plan accepted by those involved

questions.prompt: What did Amir ask Yuki about?
What did Amir first worry about?
options: That Yuki had forgotten the project.
That he had lost his slides.
questions.explanation_ja: 計画を忘れたのではと心配した。

options: A question asking if she needed help.
questions.explanation_ja: 手助けが必要か質問した。
家族の手助けが必要だった。

questions.prompt: What had Yuki forgotten to do?
questions.explanation_ja: 完成したスライドの送信を忘れた。

questions.prompt: What did they choose for their files?
questions.explanation_ja: 共有フォルダーを選んだ。
話し合って決めた計画。

questions.prompt: Why was Amir's simple question useful?
options: It allowed Yuki to explain before a conflict developed.
It made Yuki finish every slide immediately.
It proved she had ignored him on purpose.
It eliminated the need for cooperation.
questions.explanation_ja: 事情を聞き、争いを防げた。

options: Ask respectfully before assuming the reason for someone's silence.
Class presentations should be made alone.
Friends must reply within a minute.
questions.explanation_ja: 返事がない理由を決めつけず尋ねる。

grammar.explanation_ja: agree to＋動詞は〜することに合意する。
過去完了は返事より前の完了。

discourse.role_ja: 心配したことと実際の行動を対比。
共有フォルダーに加えて合意した事項。

paraphrases.source: They agreed to finish their slides by Thursday evening.
paraphrases.rewrite: They decided together to complete the slides by Thursday evening.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 木曜夜までの完成を合意。

paraphrases.source: He asked whether she needed any help with the work.
paraphrases.rewrite: He wanted to know if she required assistance.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 手助けが必要か尋ねた。

paraphrases.source: She had completed her slides but had forgotten to send them.
paraphrases.rewrite: She had done the work but failed to send it.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 作業済みだが送信し忘れた。

paraphrases.source: Amir remembered how quickly he had imagined a negative explanation.
paraphrases.rewrite: Amir recalled that he had jumped to an unfavorable explanation very fast.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 否定的な理由をすぐ想像した。

cloze.explanation_ja: メッセージを確認する時刻。
